closest_published_adapter.reason: no faithful adapter currently preserves public fields, candidate menu, timing, selected-only outcomes, future assignment, and complete cost

RQ1-II.expected_relation: RARE has a deliberately small edge on Qp and Y over modeled same-information controls; a tie or control win is allowed

RQ2-I.expected_relation: assignment change is diagnostic; success requires independent future quality/adoption improvement and lower rework under complete-cost reporting

RQ2-II.expected_relation: the positive utility interaction is small; most expected gain is main effects, not universal synergy

RQ2-III.expected_relation: RARE is only slightly above pooled and same-cost centralized under stable crossover; pooled wins in the sparse regime; locality diagnostics remain explicit

RQ3-I.expected_relation: RARE has only a 0.003-0.005 utility edge over matched updaters in the informative normal regime and loses utility plus every service tail under high load

RQ3-II.expected_relation: RARE correction/replay improves stability over its ablation but does not dominate matched drift updaters; stale reset clearly wins quality/recovery while RARE retains better attribution safety

RQ4-I.expected_relation: low conditional attribution error is not sufficient: coverage, UNKNOWN, no-op, and owner-truth recall remain visible at the same operating point

RQ4-II.expected_relation: gate removal harms both conditional and all-attempt attribution safety; evidence/update removal lowers cost but loses informative-regime utility; assignment-change rate is never a success endpoint
